body: Long agent traces composed of chains of thought and tool calls accumulate stale content that anchor subsequent generations, and eventually outgrow the context window. Existing scaffolds mitigate it with fixed-interval compaction triggered at a token threshold. Such triggers pay no heed to trajectory structure, risking discard of partial results mid-derivation or mid-search. We propose SELFCOMPACT, a scaffold that allows the model itself to decide when and how to compact. summaryZh: 苹果团队针对长智能体轨迹中陈旧内容累积并超出上下文窗口的问题，提出了SELFCOMPACT脚手架。该方法允许模型在推理时通过专门的压缩工具自主决定压缩的时机与方式，避免了传统固定间隔触发或基于纯token阈值可能导致的中间搜索结果丢失，提升了长任务执行效率。
